half: BEFORE — current prompt shape, prior to any reordering in reckon prompts.py
method: Byte-level shared prefix computed directly from the dispatched prompt files. NOT an endpoint replay: a 12KB prompt is ~88 block queries against ~1.16M ambient queries per 45s window (0.0076%), so a delta measurement would read noise, not cache. This method is exact, needs no endpoint, is immune to residual cache from the original dispatches, and is reproducible byte-identically after the fix.
why_this_is_the_right_quantity: vLLM prefix caching matches blocks from position 0 while bytes are identical, so shared_prefix_bytes bounds the achievable cross-worker hit fraction on a first turn. The engine-side rate follows mechanically from this number.
refutation: After the fix, this same computation on fresh prompts must show a materially larger shared prefix. No movement refutes the placement hypothesis.
